title: Steampunk Camera Gear Assembly Workbench
description: Users operate a steampunk camera product configurator where internal gear mechanisms must be assembled, tuned, and calibrated. Dragging gears into designated slots inside the camera body adjusts linked parameters like aperture, focus distance, and shutter speed through a coupled mechanical system. A conservation law ensures total gear-train torque remains balanced, and full undo/redo support lets users experiment freely.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that loads steampunk_camera.glb centered on a workbench and gears.glb as a source for 5 individual gear instances arranged on a side tray. Use GLTFLoader and OrbitControls. Set up a warm workshop environment: a PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,5) looking at origin, HemisphereLight (warm amber top, cool blue bottom), one DirectionalLight with soft shadows, and a wooden-textured plane as the workbench surface. The camera model should have 5 glowing socket indicators (small torus outlines) on its body representing: Aperture Gear, Focus Gear, Shutter Gear, Film-Advance Gear, and Zoom Gear. Implement drag-and-drop (raycaster + pointer events) so users pick gears from the tray and snap them into sockets. Each placed gear spins at a base RPM. Implement multi-input coupling: Aperture and Shutter gears are inversely linked (increasing one decreases the other) to conserve an Exposure Value (EV) total shown in a HUD. Focus and Zoom gears are coupled so total optical-path-length is conserved. The Film-Advance gear acts as a master that scales all other gear speeds proportionally. Display a top-right HTML overlay HUD showing: EV total, optical-path value, each gear RPM, and a torque-balance meter. Clicking a placed gear opens a radial slider to adjust its size (0.5x-2x), which changes its RPM inversely (conservation of angular momentum: radius*speed=constant). Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y tracking every action (place, remove, resize) in a history stack of at least 20 entries. Right-clicking a placed gear removes it back to the tray. Add subtle particle steam effects from the camera when all 5 gears are placed and balanced. Total interaction steps to fully assemble and calibrate: 10-14. Include a reset button that animates all gears back to the tray.
